data.title: AI Root Cause Analysis Shifts from Model Reasoning to Context Engineering
data.description: Engineers are increasingly arguing that modern LLMs can already reason through root cause analysis once given correctly prepared context, shifting the hard problem to the pipelines that correlate telemetry. A Coroot experiment across eleven models offers early evidence for the claim.
